digest:
## 🔬 Major Technical Developments

### 1-Click GitHub Token Stealing via a VSCode Bug
URL: https://blog.ammaraskar.com/github-token-stealing/
Critical supply chain vulnerability exposes developer credentials through ubiquitous IDE
A single-click exploit in VSCode can exfiltrate GitHub tokens, potentially compromising entire codebases and CI/CD pipelines. Given VSCode's market dominance among developers, the blast radius here is enormous. This is exactly the type of vulnerability that makes software supply chain insurance increasingly expensive and necessary.

### MAI-Code-1-Flash
URL: https://microsoft.ai/news/introducingmai-code-1-flash/
Microsoft ships lightweight coding model optimized for speed over raw capability
Microsoft continues building out its AI model portfolio with a flash-tier coding assistant, following the naming convention established by Google's Gemini Flash variants. The strategic play is clear: offer tiered models to capture both latency-sensitive and capability-intensive use cases. Watch for this to slot into Copilot's backend as a cost optimization lever.

### Google rolls out fake call detection to protect against AI deepfake impersonation scams
URL: https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/02/google-rolls-out-fake-call-detection-to-protect-against-ai-deepfake-impersonation-scams/
Google deploys on-device detection as AI-generated voice fraud reaches consumer-scale threat levels
This is defensive AI infrastructure becoming table stakes at the OS level. The fact that Google is shipping this now signals deepfake voice attacks have crossed the threshold from edge case to endemic. Telco fraud detection vendors should expect commoditization pressure.


## 💼 Business & Market Signals

### Cyera eyes $12B valuation at 80x ARR multiple despite operating losses
URL: https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/02/cyera-eyes-12b-valuation-at-80x-arr-multiple-despite-operating-losses/
Data security startup commands eye-watering multiple as AI data governance becomes board-level priority
Cyera's $300M round at 80x ARR is a clear signal that investors are betting big on AI-era data security infrastructure. The multiple reflects expected category leadership in a market where every enterprise suddenly needs to know where their training data lives. Evolution Equity leading suggests smart money sees this as infrastructure, not point solution.

### Uber caps employee AI spending after blowing through budget in 4 months
URL: https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/02/uber-caps-employee-ai-spending-after-blowing-through-budget-in-four-months/
Enterprise AI adoption hits economic reality as internal consumption spirals
Uber burned through its annual AI tooling budget in four months after encouraging aggressive adoption. This is the canary in the coal mine for enterprise AI unit economics. Expect CFOs across the Fortune 500 to implement similar controls in Q3, which creates headwinds for per-seat AI SaaS pricing models.

### Ex-Anduril engineer raises $42M to build the Amazon of composite parts
URL: https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/02/ex-anduril-engineer-raises-42m-to-build-the-amazon-of-composite-parts/
Defense-tech talent spins out to attack aerospace supply chain bottleneck
Layup Parts is tackling composite manufacturing, a critical chokepoint for defense and aerospace production. The Anduril pedigree signals credibility with DoD procurement, and the "Amazon of composites" pitch suggests a marketplace model that could aggregate fragmented supplier capacity. Worth watching as defense industrial base investments accelerate.


## 📋 Case Studies & Deep Dives

### AI outperforms law professors in Stanford Law study
URL: https://law.stanford.edu/press/ai-outperforms-law-professors-in-stanford-law-study/
Rigorous academic benchmark validates AI legal analysis capabilities against expert baseline
Stanford's study provides the cleanest comparison yet of AI versus human expert performance in legal reasoning. This has direct implications for legal tech valuations and BigLaw operating models. The finding will accelerate adoption conversations at AmLaw 100 firms while intensifying associate-level workforce concerns.

### Microsoft launches Scout, an OpenClaw-inspired personal assistant
URL: https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/02/microsoft-launches-scout-an-openclaw-inspired-personal-assistant/
Microsoft fast-follows open source agent framework with enterprise-grade M365 integration
Scout's Build launch shows Microsoft's playbook: let the open source community prove out agent architectures, then ship a first-party version with deep product integration. The OpenClaw reference is notable since Microsoft is explicitly crediting community innovation while capturing enterprise value. Expect Scout to be bundled into Copilot Pro within 12 months.


## ⚡ Signal vs. Noise

The Cyera valuation and Uber spending cap tell the same story from opposite ends: AI infrastructure is repricing rapidly while consumption economics remain unresolved. The market is simultaneously betting on data governance as critical infrastructure and discovering that uncapped AI access creates uncontrollable OpEx. The composites startup and defense-adjacent security funding suggest smart capital is rotating toward physical-world AI applications and hardened infrastructure, hedging against pure software plays. Watch for more discipline on AI spend and more conviction on AI security.
